customer.business: May11Leven Labs, a small design and technology studio (brand identity, websites, apps, 3D, automation, AI agents, content) that markets itself on Instagram and LinkedIn
customer.target: Owners and managers of small hotels, guesthouses, lodges and boutique villas (5-30 rooms) in coastal and safari East Africa and the Gulf, who get guests from Instagram and Booking.com
customer.where: Lamu, Diani, Watamu, Zanzibar, Arusha, Nairobi, Kigali, Musanze first; Dubai, Muscat second. Scrolling Instagram or LinkedIn on a phone.

segments.name: Owner or GM of a 12-30 room boutique hotel or lodge
Marketing or revenue lead at a small hotel group

behaviours.name: OTA-dependent
behaviours.how: Gets most bookings from Booking.com and Airbnb, hates the commission but fears losing visibility.

behaviours.name: Instagram-led
behaviours.how: Gets enquiries by DM and WhatsApp from their own posts, handles payment by bank transfer or M-Pesa.

behaviours.name: Price-first
behaviours.how: Assumes agencies are expensive; has a cheap template site from a local developer.

behaviours.name: Trust-checker
behaviours.how: Wants to see real hotels the studio has worked with and real booking numbers.

behaviours.name: Design-aware
behaviours.how: Follows design hotels and Design Hotels-style accounts, cares about the brand feeling.

behaviours.name: Already has a booking engine
behaviours.how: Uses a channel manager and booking engine (SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, Nightsbridge) already.

objections: Guests trust Booking.com more than my own website
I already pay for a booking engine or channel manager
A remote studio does not know my island or my guests
It is probably too expensive for a small guesthouse
This is a made-up hotel, not a real result
Pretty design does not fill rooms in low season
habits: you answer guest WhatsApps yourself late at night
a guest no-showed last week and you still paid commission
your neighbour lodge just launched a new website
you are planning to raise rates for high season

pitch:
A LinkedIn document post and Instagram carousel from May11Leven Labs, a design and technology studio. Clearly labelled "Concept: Kusi House, Lamu".
Slide 1: a phone in a hand on a wooden boat bench at a jetty, showing a simple arrival page opened from a WhatsApp link (nothing to download): "Your boat leaves Manda jetty at 14:20. Ali will meet you."
Slide 2: "Keep Booking.com for new guests. Stop paying it for the guests who already found you on Instagram, and for the ones who come back."
Slide 3: a worked example, labelled "illustration": 9 rooms, $120 a night. If 10 bookings a month of 3 nights come direct instead of through an 18% commission, the guesthouse keeps about $650 a month.
Slide 4: the direct booking page on the guesthouse's own site, plugged into the booking engine it already uses (SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, Nightsbridge). "Book direct: boat transfer and breakfast included." A small M-Pesa or card deposit holds the room, and a reminder goes out the day before, so fewer no-shows.
Slide 5: "Concept by May11Leven Labs. Brand, booking page, arrival page, WhatsApp reminders. Brand identity from $800. Free tool: work out what commission costs you at the link in bio. Comment 11 and we'll run your numbers with you."
Caption first line: "Your guests find you on Instagram. Then someone else takes a cut of the booking."
Ask: try the free commission calculator, or comment 11 and we'll run your numbers with you.
